pages.text: Dry grassland under flat-topped acacias and Regions Unexplored's huge baobabs. This is where Naturalist's big animals live: $(bold)elephants$(), $(bold)giraffes$(), $(bold)zebras$() (which you can ride), $(bold)rhinos$() and $(bold)lions$() (which hunt you back). Horses, llamas and villages too.$(br2)Acacia needs $(bold)Woodcutting 30$() to chop. See $(l:lemursaucepacket:skills)Skills$(/l).
